run_glue_transfer_tasks: run the glue-xnli script to fine-tune a pretrained XLM model on GLUE benchmark tasks
run_xnli_transfer_tasks: run the glue-xnli script to fine-tune a pretrained XLM model on the XNLI cross-lingual NLI task
reload_sentence_embedder: reload a pretrained SentenceEmbedder model from a saved checkpoint path for downstream transfer learning
configure_finetune_layers: configure which encoder layers to finetune using the --finetune_layers argument with slice notation
setup_batch_parameters: setup batch size and token-based batching parameters for efficient training on GLUE or XNLI tasks
